production.note: US model years. KBB lists the Exige S for 2007 and 2008 only (the 2009 page redirects to 2008); kbb-exige-s-2007 lists the 2007 car. Lotus Cars USA announced it on 30 November 2006 as 'expected in limited numbers at dealerships throughout the U.S. later this year'. The 2008 to 2011 Exige S 240 and Exige S 260 are separate, more powerful models, and the later V6 Exige S was never sold in the US (Motor Authority, motorauthority-exige-v6: 'Lotus' Exige S is ban from sale in the U.S. due to the car not meeting local airbag safety regulations').

body.note: Cars.com: '2dr Coupe S'. Two-seat mid-engined fixed-roof coupe.

displacementL.note: 'the 1.8 liter engine' (Lotus Cars USA); Cars.com: '1.8L/110'. The cc figure was not seen on an opened page.

aspiration.note: 'The addition of a supercharger and intercooler to the 1.8 liter engine'

powerHp.note: Quote (Lotus Cars USA release, 30 November 2006): "The addition of a supercharger and intercooler to the 1.8 liter engine has raised the horsepower 16 percent (to 220 hp from 190)" (repeated on a second request). MotorWeek's 2007 test (motorweek-exige-s-2007) also gives 220. KBB lists 218 hp for the 2008 Exige S (kbb-exige-s-2008).

weightLb.note: Quote (Lotus Cars USA release): "Weighing just 2,077 pounds, the Exige S sprints to 60 mph in a blistering 4.1 seconds" (repeated on a second request). Cars.com lists 'Base Curb Weight 2,077 lbs' for the 2007 Exige S and MotorWeek says it 'tips the scales at 2,077' pounds. Single body and transmission.
